stem: Based on the two diagrams, which list correctly identifies the relationships Glyptapanteles wasp larvae have with other organisms?

options.label: G
options.text:
Competition: geometrid moths
Commensalism: stinkbugs
Mutualism: guava and eucalyptus trees

options.label: H
options.text:
Competition: stinkbugs and geometrid moths
Commensalism: guava and eucalyptus trees

options.label: J
options.text:
Parasitism: geometrid moths
Commensalism: stinkbugs
Mutualism: guava and eucalyptus trees

visual_elements:
Partial Food Web diagram showing arrows:
Guava fruit -> Geometrid moth caterpillars
Eucalyptus leaves -> Geometrid moth caterpillars
Geometrid moth caterpillars -> Glyptapanteles wasp larvae
Geometrid moth caterpillars -> Stinkbug
notes: The problem explicitly asks which list identifies relationships based on the diagrams shown.
